title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About Rocketlane**
--------------------


Rocketlane is a fast\-growing, innovative SaaS company redefining how professional services teams deliver customer projects. We recently raised **$60M in Series C funding led by Insight Partners**, bringing our total funding to over $105M from top investors including 8VC, Matrix Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners, along with super angels like Gokul Rajaram, Girish Mathrubootham, and Clark Valberg.


Our mission? To move the professional services industry from tracking work to *executing it*. With **Nitro**, our agentic execution platform, we've built the industry's first AI\-powered engine that configures systems, runs migrations, generates documentation, and surfaces delivery risks \- directly inside customer project workflows. We're a team of 200\+ passionate folks building a product that services teams love, and we're just getting started on the Outcome Era.


**What will you do? (Role Overview)**
-------------------------------------


As a **Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)** on Rocketlane's AI Implementation team, you will own the technical success of our strategic customers as they adopt **Nitro AI agents**. You'll embed with customer teams \- running discovery, designing agent workflows, configuring integrations, engineering prompts, and shipping production\-grade apps and agents that drive measurable outcomes.


This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership role that sits at the intersection of engineering, product, and customer success. You'll understand customer workflows, orchestrate agents, write code debug live issues, and translate what you learn in the field into product improvements that shape the future of Nitro. If "professional services consultant" feels too removed from the keyboard and "pure product engineer" feels too removed from the customer, this role is built for you.


You'll be a founding member of our AI\-first Professional Services org \- someone who thrives in ambiguity, loves solving puzzles, and is energized by seeing their work live in production within weeks, not quarters.


**What You'll Be Responsible For**
----------------------------------


### **Customer\-Embedded Agent Deployment**


* Own end\-to\-end deployment of Nitro AI agents for enterprise customers \- from discovery and solution design to configuration, go\-live, and ongoing optimization.
* Lead technical discovery sessions with customer stakeholders (Services leaders, IT, Operations, Revenue teams) to map business workflows to Nitro agent capabilities.
* Design agent architectures that solve real delivery problems: migration agents, workforce agents, documentation agents and custom workflows tailored to each customer's environment.
* Build and deploy custom integrations between Nitro and customer systems (CRM, HRMS, ERP, Finance tools, data warehouses, internal APIs).

### **Hands\-On Engineering**


* Write production\-grade code/ scripts to extend, customize, or integrate Nitro agents into customer workflows.
* Engineer prompts, design evaluation frameworks, and tune agent behavior for customer\-specific data, terminology, and edge cases.
* Build data pipelines and connectors to feed agents with the right context \- SOWs, project history, customer communications, and structured delivery data.
* Debug live agent behavior in customer environments, perform root\-cause analysis on complex system interactions, and ship fixes fast.

### **Trusted Technical Advisor**


* Serve as the technical point of contact for strategic accounts throughout their Nitro implementation journey.
* Guide customers toward best\-practice implementations \- and push back when needed. Your job is to advise, not just execute requirements.
* Translate customer pain into clear problem statements, then into shipped solutions. Our model is simple: spend time understanding customer workflows, then build agents.

### **Product Feedback Loop**


* Be the voice of the customer inside Rocketlane. Surface patterns, edge cases, and feature gaps to our Product and Engineering teams.
* Prototype and validate new agent capabilities in the field before they become full product investments.
* Contribute to internal playbooks, reusable agent templates, and scaled enablement content so every FDE engagement makes the next one faster.

### **Pre\-Sales \& POC Support**


* Partner with Sales and Solutions teams on high\-stakes enterprise deals \- building rapid POCs, running technical validations, and proving the business case for Nitro.
* Represent Rocketlane's technical depth in customer executive conversations, demos, and architecture reviews.

**Must\-Have Skills**
---------------------


### **Engineering \& Technical Depth**


* **3–5 years of hands\-on software engineering/product management experience**, with the ability to write production\-grade code in at least one of Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or similar.
* Strong command of **REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth/auth flows, and enterprise integration patterns** \- you can read API docs, test endpoints, and ship integrations without hand\-holding.
* Good understanding of **data modeling and ETL** \- comfortable working with messy enterprise data and shaping it for production use.
* Comfortable with modern cloud, DevOps, and integration tooling (Postman, AWS/GCP, Docker, iPaaS platforms like Workato/Boomi/Make).

### **AI \& Agent Engineering**


* **Hands\-on experience building with LLMs and AI agent frameworks** \- prompt engineering, agent orchestration and evaluation/guardrails.
* Comfortable using AI\-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Replit, Lovable, or similar) to move faster and build utilities that make deployments scalable.
* Strong intuition for when to use an agent vs. deterministic automation, and how to design human\-in\-the\-loop workflows that customers trust.

### **Customer\-Facing Instincts**


* 1\+ years in a customer\-facing technical role \- Solutions Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, Technical Consulting, Implementation, or similar at a B2B SaaS or AI company.
* Proven ability to drive enterprise deployments end\-to\-end with minimal supervision, including discovery, solutioning, and leading technical conversations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication \- you can sit in a room with a VP of Services and earn their trust, then turn around and write clean technical documentation.
* Ability to simplify complex AI concepts for non\-technical stakeholders

### **Problem\-Solving \& Ownership**


* **Bias toward action and ownership.** You see a problem, you fix it. You don't wait for a ticket.
* Strong first\-principles thinking \- you can decompose a messy customer problem into a solvable, shippable plan.
* Thrives in ambiguity. Comfortable operating without a playbook, because you're often the one writing it.

**Good\-to\-Have Skills**
-------------------------


* Experience with **Professional Services Automation (PSA) tools** \- Rocketlane, Asana, Wrike, ClickUp, Salesforce PSA, Kantata, etc.
* Background in **Professional Services, Customer Success Engineering, or technical implementation** at enterprise SaaS companies.
* Prior exposure to building or deploying **agentic AI systems** in production at an AI\-native or AI\-forward company.

**You Should Apply If You:**
----------------------------


* Want to be at the frontline of deploying real, production AI agents that change how businesses operate \- not just build another chatbot.
* Love owning customer outcomes end\-to\-end and thrive on the blend of engineering and customer conversations.
* Get energized by solving puzzles in ambiguous environments where the playbook is still being written.
* Are driven by autonomy, impact, and building something that scales \- and want to help define what "Forward Deployed Engineer" means at Rocketlane.

**Why Join Us?**
----------------


At Rocketlane, we're all about building a great product *and* a great place to work. Here's why you'll actually look forward to Mondays:


* **Impact and ownership:** You won't just be another cog in the machine; here, you're more like a turbocharged engine part. Bring your ideas, make them happen.
* **Work with the best:** We're a team of passionate, quirky, and ridiculously talented people. Come for the work, stay for the memes.
* **Celebrate wins:** Whether we're hitting major milestones or celebrating new funding, we like to mix it up. From rap videos to team outings, we believe in celebrating big.
* **Learn and grow:** We're all about learning \- and not just the latest SaaS trends. You'll grow your career, pick up new skills, and work on problems that most engineers only read about.
* **Front\-row seat to the AI era:** You'll build with frontier models, deploy real agents into real enterprises, and see your work drive measurable business outcomes in weeks.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits:** Comprehensive health coverage, flexible time off, and benefits designed to support you and your family.

title: Data Consultant (1 Year Contract)
description:
Discover an exciting opportunity to work at the intersection of data, technology, and client success, helping global investment industry clients unlock the full value of their data.


As a Data Consultant, you will play a pivotal role in delivering exceptional client experiences by leading the onboarding journey for new clients and helping them achieve their data objectives. Working within our Centre of Excellence, you will collaborate with clients, sales teams, project stakeholders, and internal specialists to deliver tailored data solutions, ensuring a smooth transition from sale through to implementation. This role offers the opportunity to solve complex challenges, influence client outcomes, develop specialist expertise in data integration, and contribute to the ongoing success of a global financial technology business.


FE fundinfo is a leading financial data provider, connecting the investment industry across the UK, Europe, and Asia\-Pacific through an integrated platform. Our skilled team empowers clients with data\-driven insights, making the industry Navigate Complexity with Confidence!

**Your key responsibilities as a Data Consultant will include:**

* Engage with clients to understand their data requirements, challenges, and business objectives during onboarding and implementation activities.
* Analyse client needs and implement effective data solutions that align with project delivery objectives and agreed timelines.
* Identify, acquire, validate, and integrate relevant data sources while ensuring data quality, accuracy, and compliance standards are met.
* Collaborate closely with internal teams to deliver seamless and integrated solutions that meet client expectations.
* Provide data expertise during pre\-sales discovery activities, supporting tailored client solutions and business growth initiatives.
* Maintain adherence to company security policies and all data\-related governance requirements.

**You will need the following experience and skills to join us as a Data Consultant:**

* You have experience or strong knowledge of data collection, transformation, analysis, or data integration.
* You possess excellent problem\-solving skills and can analyse complex data challenges to deliver effective solutions.
* You communicate confidently with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders and can explain complex concepts clearly.
* You thrive in collaborative environments while also managing individual responsibilities and multiple priorities effectively.
* You have strong technical proficiency in data management and analysis, with advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel and excellent English language skills.

**Apply today for immediate consideration and we will endeavour to get back to you within 5 working days. Visit our** **Glassdoor** **profile or** **fefundinfo.com** **to find out more about life @ FE fundinfo!**

title: Pre Sales Executive / Senior Presales Executive
description:
Job Description:

We are looking for enthusiastic and result\-oriented Pre\-Sales Executives / Senior Executives with prior experience in the real estate industry. The candidate will be responsible for handling customer enquiries, understanding customer requirements, explaining projects, generating interest, and coordinating site visits with the sales team.

The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, good knowledge of the real estate market, and the ability to effectively convert enquiries into site visits and potential sales.

Handle incoming enquiries through calls, digital leads, referrals, and other sources.

Understand customer requirements, budget, location preferences, and property needs.

Explain project details, specifications, amenities, pricing, payment plans, and USPs to prospective customers.

Follow up with prospective customers regularly and maintain lead records.

Qualify leads and identify genuine prospects for further engagement.

Coordinate and schedule site visits for prospective customers.

Coordinate with the sales team to ensure smooth site visit arrangements and customer handover.

Follow up with customers after site visits and update lead status.

Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, follow\-ups, site visits, and conversions in CRM.

Work closely with the Sales, Marketing, CRM, and Site teams for effective lead management.

Ensure timely follow\-up on all assigned leads and achieve defined conversion targets.

Maintain good customer relationships throughout the pre\-sales process.

Provide regular updates and reports on lead status, site visits, and conversions to the reporting manager.

Pay: ₹300,000\.00 \- ₹360,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Presales - Real Estate
description:
We are looking for an enthusiastic and customer\-oriented Presales Executive to handle leads, interact with prospective customers, understand their property requirements and generate qualified leads and site visits for Manju Groups real\-estate projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Handle and respond to leads received through digital marketing, Naukri campaigns, calls, enquiries and other sources.
* Make outbound calls to prospective customers and introduce Manju Groups projects.
* Understand customer requirements such as budget, preferred location, property type and investment plans.
* Explain project details including location, amenities, specifications, pricing, offers and payment options.
* Qualify leads based on customer interest, requirement, budget and purchase timeline.
* Follow up with interested customers regularly through calls and messages.
* Convince and motivate qualified customers to schedule site visits.
* Coordinate with the Sales Team for site visits and further customer follow\-up.
* Maintain accurate lead and customer information in MMS/CRM.
* Update lead status, call details, follow\-up dates, customer responses and site\-visit details on a daily basis.
* Maintain daily lead and follow\-up reports.
* Achieve assigned call, follow\-up, qualified\-lead and site\-visit targets.
* Ensure timely follow\-up with every assigned lead and avoid missed opportunities.
* Build and maintain positive relationships with prospective customers.
* Work closely with the Sales and Marketing teams to improve lead conversion.

**Required Skills**

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good Tamil and English communication skills.
* Strong convincing and negotiation skills.
* Good customer handling and follow\-up skills.
* Target\-oriented and self motivated.
* Ability to handle multiple leads and follow\-ups efficiently.

**Qualification \& Experience**

Any Bachelor's degree.

Experience in Real Estate Presales, Telesales, Telecalling, Customer Support or Sales will be an added advantage

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Technical Consultant - D365 F&O
description:
Are you a passionate Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance \& Operations Technical Developer looking to grow in enterprise application development, technical solutioning, automation, and digital transformation?


Join LevelShift as a D365 F\&O Technical Developer, where youll work with functional consultants, project managers, technical teams, and business stakeholders to understand requirements, develop and customize D365 F\&O solutions, build integrations and automation, and support implementation, deployment, production support, and continuous improvement.

  

  

**What You'll Do**


As a D365 F\&O Technical Developer at LevelShift, you will:


Understand business and functional requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions within D365 F\&O.


Design, develop, customize, document, test, deploy, and maintain D365 F\&O technical solutions, extensions, forms, workflows, reports, and integrations.


Build and enhance automation solutions using Power Automate, Power Platform, Azure services, and other Microsoft technologies to improve business process efficiency.


Develop integrations between D365 F\&O and external applications using REST APIs, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, middleware, and other integration technologies.


Participate in technical design discussions, solution architecture reviews, estimations, implementation planning, and code reviews.


Troubleshoot application issues, perform root\-cause analysis, optimize system performance, and ensure adherence to development best practices and coding standards.


Support data migration, deployments, release management, environment maintenance, testing, UAT, production support, and post\-go\-live activities.


Collaborate with functional consultants and business stakeholders to validate requirements and ensure alignment between functional and technical solutions.


Prepare and maintain technical documentation, design documents, deployment guides, integration specifications, and support documentation.


Support pre\-sales activities through technical solution inputs, effort estimations, demos, proof\-of\-concepts, and proposal contributions.


Provide daily status updates covering progress, risks, issues, dependencies, and action items.


Mentor junior developers, participate in knowledge sharing, technical training, interviews, and organizational initiatives.


Recommend technical improvements, automation opportunities, development tools, and process enhancements to improve project and team efficiency.


Follow information security policies, report security events or weaknesses, and participate in BCP and fire drill exercises as applicable.

  

  

**How this role uses AI**


Use AI tools responsibly to improve development productivity, accelerate coding, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and technical analysis.


Apply AI\-assisted tools for requirement analysis, code generation, test case creation, technical documentation, issue analysis, debugging, and solution recommendations.


Leverage Microsoft Copilot, Dynamics 365 Copilot, Power Platform AI, Agents, Azure AI Services, and other cloud\-based AI tools to improve development efficiency and business outcomes.

  

  

**Your Skillset**


Strong hands\-on experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance \& Operations (D365 F\&O) development, customization, implementation, and support.


Strong technical development experience using X\+\+, .NET, and D365 F\&O development frameworks.


Experience developing and maintaining custom solutions, extensions, forms, workflows, reports, and integrations within D365 F\&O.


Strong understanding of D365 F\&O architecture, development lifecycle, customization, troubleshooting, deployment, and performance optimization.


Experience designing and implementing integrations between D365 F\&O and external applications using REST APIs, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, middleware, and related technologies.


Hands\-on experience with Power Automate, Power Platform, and Azure services for automation and business process improvement.


Experience with data migration, deployments, release management, environment maintenance, production support, and issue resolution.


Ability to participate in technical design discussions, architecture reviews, estimations, code reviews, and implementation planning.


Ability to translate functional requirements into scalable technical solutions and collaborate effectively with functional consultants and business stakeholders.


Exposure to Microsoft Copilot, Dynamics 365 Copilot, AI\-assisted development tools, Agents, Power Platform AI, and Azure AI Services is desirable.


Excellent communication, stakeholder management, analytical, problem\-solving, documentation, and troubleshooting skills.


Ability to mentor junior team members and contribute to recruitment, interviews, technical trainings, certifications, knowledge sharing, process improvement, information security, responsible AI adoption, and operational excellence.

  

  

**Why LevelShift?**


Grow your career through enterprise\-scale D365 Finance \& Operations development, customization, integrations, automation, and digital transformation initiatives.


Gain exposure to Power Platform, Azure, Copilot, Agents, AI\-assisted development tools, and modern Microsoft business application technologies.


Work with experienced functional consultants, project managers, technical specialists, and cross\-functional teams in a collaborative, innovation\-focused environment.


Build strong technical expertise across D365 F\&O development, integrations, automation, deployment, production support, and solution architecture.


Access continuous learning, certification support, formal trainings, technical knowledge sharing, and exposure to emerging AI\-powered enterprise technologies.
